title: Difficulties adding EDAWR Library
description:
I am trying to add EDAWR library to my R studio, I am getting this error: 

> devtools::install_github("rstudio/EDAWR")
> Error in curl::curl_fetch_disk(url, x$path, handle = handle) :

Can you help me? I am very new to R
